system.docHtml: The caster strikes the ground with a hand, foot, or elemental focus, and a wave of trembling Physéra energy radiates outward from the point of impact, sending a mild but persistent earth tremor rippling Index x 5 feet out. Although the tremor is not powerful enough to damage structures, it forces every moving or standing creature within its radius—except the caster—to make a Stumble Roll at the start of each turn for the spell's duration, with a -20 penalty applied to the check on Critical Success. Moreover, all movement within the affected area becomes Difficult, halving travel speed as the shaking ground makes every step uncertain.
